description: Generated from agents/*.md frontmatter by scripts/gen-agent-registry.sh — do not hand-edit. capability_ids is a back-reference from registries/capabilities.json.

agents.name: android-builder
agents.description: Android build-and-release engineer — source to Google Play, end to end. Branches: BUILD (artifact only) | BETA (internal/beta track, default) | RELEASE (production track — explicit instruction only). Never touches iOS, backend, or web code.

agents.name: architecture-analyst
agents.description: System-comprehension and onboarding-docs specialist. Branches: `/analyze-architecture` (autonomous analysis of modules, dependencies and patterns into code-grounded docs for new developers) | `/talk-about-the-system` (interviews the human to fill the gaps code can't answer). Alias: ricardo-fagmer.

agents.name: audit-consolidator
agents.description: Merges specialist reports into one consolidated status report — top-line verdict, root cause, ordered remediation plan. Read-only; may read Jira via the atlassian MCP but never writes to it. Dispatched last by the audit orchestrator. Alias: danilo.

agents.name: backend-coordinator
agents.description: NestJS/TypeScript backend specialist — modules, controllers, services, DTOs, data access, repositories, queues, workers, migrations. Reads the resolved stack first and loads nestjs-patterns. Branches: AUDIT (read-only findings) | IMPLEMENT (writes code). Alias: borisenko.

agents.name: cicd-specialist
agents.description: Read-only CI/CD specialist — GitHub workflows, Actions runs, PR/CI status, branch protection, via the github MCP and the repo's workflow files. Never edits workflows or merges. Dispatched by the audit orchestrator. Alias: gustavo.

agents.name: critic
agents.description: Adversarial correctness review of work that is about to be called done. Dispatched when risk=high per rules/risk-autonomy.md, when the release gate requires an independent pass per rules/gates.md, or on explicit request. Tries to refute the claim that the work is correct and complete — the general-correctness counterpart to security-reviewer's security-only lens. Read-only, never edits. Alias: rogerio.

agents.name: dba-coordinator
agents.description: Data-layer specialist — schema design, migrations, query performance, indexing, access patterns, across Postgres/Oracle and other relational stores. Branches: AUDIT (read-only findings) | IMPLEMENT (writes migrations/queries). Alias: ronaldo.

agents.name: devops-coordinator
agents.description: DevOps/infra specialist — CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, Terraform/IaC, cloud resources, observability config. Branches: AUDIT (read-only findings) | IMPLEMENT (writes config). Alias: hinokuma.

agents.name: docs-writer
agents.description: Writes and updates documentation for work that already landed — READMEs, usage docs, endpoint and config references. Use when a delivered change leaves documentation stale, or when a headless workflow needs documentation as its own step rather than an afterthought. Documents what the code actually does, never what it was supposed to do. Alias: dalollio.

agents.name: frontend-coordinator
agents.description: Frontend specialist — React/Next components, pages/app router, state, data fetching, forms, styling, performance, accessibility. Branches: AUDIT (read-only findings) | IMPLEMENT (writes code). Alias: arturo.

agents.name: gcp-specialist
agents.description: Read-only Google Cloud specialist — compute, storage, IAM, networking, billing signals, via the gcp MCP. Never mutates cloud resources. Dispatched by the audit orchestrator. Alias: gcp.

agents.name: ios-builder
agents.description: iOS build-and-release engineer — source to the Apple store, end to end. Branches: BUILD (artifact only) | BETA (TestFlight, default) | RELEASE (submit for App Store review — explicit instruction only). Never touches Android, backend, or web code.

agents.name: kubernetes-specialist
agents.description: Read-only Kubernetes specialist — workloads, events, resource usage, config, via the kubernetes MCP. Never mutates the cluster. Dispatched by the audit orchestrator. Alias: corradin.

agents.name: llm-coordinator
agents.description: LLM/AI engineering specialist — Mastra LLM/chatbot development, prompt design, agent tools, structured output, RAG pipelines, embeddings, evals. Branches: AUDIT (read-only findings) | IMPLEMENT (writes code/prompts) | INTERVIEW (`/engineos:design-agents` — walks the agent-system-design form with the developer, writes only the topology spec and the approval line). Alias: hermsdorff.

agents.name: mobile-coordinator
agents.description: Mobile specialist (React Native) — greenfield mobile features (screens, navigation, native-module glue, offline/storage) and web->mobile mirroring, adapting web patterns to mobile idioms. Reads the web frontend as read-only reference when mirroring; writes only in the mobile app tree — never API/backend, web frontend, or DevOps/infra. Branches: AUDIT (mobile findings / parity report) | IMPLEMENT (build the feature or mirror). Alias: elias.

agents.name: oracle-specialist
agents.description: Read-only Oracle specialist — schema, indexes, execution plans, via the oracle MCP on a read-only connection. Never runs DDL/DML. Dispatched by the audit orchestrator. Alias: leo.

agents.name: postgres-specialist
agents.description: Read-only Postgres specialist — schema, indexes, query plans, via the postgres MCP pointed at a READ-ONLY role. Never runs DDL/DML. Dispatched by the audit orchestrator. Alias: pereira.

agents.name: product-spec
agents.description: Turns an objective into a spec with a problem statement, solution and testable acceptance criteria. Use when a feature-shaped objective needs a spec artifact before implementation starts — the dispatchable form of non-negotiable #1 (spec before code), for callers that need it as an agent rather than main-loop discipline. Alias: caio-badu.

agents.name: qa-tester
agents.description: Autonomous end-to-end API QA — brings the stack up from clean, discovers every endpoint, emits an inventory plus Postman collection, then exercises happy paths, negatives and chained flows headlessly via Newman and reports pass/fail. Never waits for user input (skips MFA and email-sending steps). Alias: ameer.

agents.name: router
agents.description: Resolves a request into a dispatch plan — intents, rules and skills to load, agents with disjoint file scopes, model per agent, MCP servers, risk tier, autonomy ceiling, gates and wave grouping. Runs one scripts/kernel.sh resolve call FIRST and reasons only about what that answer leaves open: intent tiebreaks the registry notes do not settle mechanically, scope decomposition against the real repo, and wave grouping. Dispatched when hooks/prompt-advisor.sh reports escalate=true, or on demand via /engineos:route. Read-only planner — it never edits, and it never dispatches the plan it produces.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.description: Adversarial security review of a diff, PR, or module. Use before merging risky changes, when the router hits review intent on code touching auth/input/data, or on explicit "security review" request. Also dispatched at edit time on security-sensitive files (auth, guard, middleware, secret, .env, credentials) by the routing hook. Read-only — reports findings, never edits. Alias: leo-ely.

agents.name: test-writer
agents.description: Writes tests from acceptance criteria, a spec, or an untested module. Use when a feature needs coverage, a bug fix needs a regression test, or tests are being backfilled. Dispatched deliberately, never automatically after ordinary changes. Alias: sameer.
